description: Stunning 2BD/2BA condo with serene pool and lush greenery views located in the heart of prime Encino. Filled with natural light, this beautifully maintained residence welcomes you with an open-concept floor plan, expansive windows, and a gorgeous fireplace that anchors the spacious living room. Sliding doors open to a private balcony overlooking the resort-style grounds, creating the perfect setting for relaxing, entertaining, or embracing that coveted indoor/outdoor California lifestyle.  The kitchen flows seamlessly into the main living space and dining area, offering ample cabinetry, generous counter space, a breakfast bar, and a modern chandelier that adds a sophisticated touch. Thoughtfully designed for ultimate privacy, the ideal split-bedroom layout places each bedroom on opposite sides of the condo. The spacious primary suite features a large closet and en-suite bathroom, while the second bedroom is perfect for guests, a home office, or flexible living space.  Additional highlights include central A/C, abundant storage, and two secured parking spaces. Residents enjoy access to an array of community amenities including a sparkling pool, spa, fitness center, community laundry, secure entry, and beautifully manicured grounds. HOA dues include water, gas, pool, gym, maintenance, and reserves. Located just moments from Ventura Blvd's popular shops, restaurants, cafes, and easy freeway access, this is an incredible opportunity to experience stylish and comfortable living in one of Encino's most desirable locations.
